That commit changed source/references.html from the inconsistent StructureDefinition/my-profile canonical to a ValueSet/my-valueset canonical, making the example family consistently about ValueSet resolution.
additional_context: The example family came from FHIR-10576's version-specific canonical-reference work. Later source evolution renamed the old valueSetUri example into current canonical/valueSet prose and split related guidance across source/references.html and source/terminologies.html. Current searches found no remaining StructureDefinition/my-profile valueSet example and no Zulip or Confluence discussion that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current authoritative source already conveys the requested corrected ValueSet semantics: source/references.html uses a ValueSet/my-valueset versioned canonical, and source/terminologies.html uses the clinical-findings ValueSet canonical with a matching ValueSet?url/version search.
